parameters.content:
## Deterministic policy → durable action → actual result
No application submission, impersonation or external profile sharing. Internal writes finish atomically. Calendar uses one stable event ID and reconciles before creating. Email has no blind retries after uncertainty. Only the connected demo user writes the separate demo calendar; every eligible user gets an owned .ics file. Credentials stay in n8n.
